depictions.name: Eboshigata Hachiman Shrine
depictions.text: Eboshigata Hachiman Shrine is a Shinto shrine dedicated to Hachiman, situated in Osaka Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was located in the eastern part of Izumi Settsu. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki member and shinobi Fujibayashi Naoe practiced her kuji-kiri while visiting the shrine.
